object: German physicist (1901–1976). Nobel Prize 1932. Published the uncertainty principle at 25 — not a practical limitation but a fundamental feature of nature. Co-architect of the Copenhagen interpretation with Bohr and the leading figure of the Knabenphysik generation that rewrote the rules of matter.
